turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: There is no single busiest weekday: every weekday (Monday through Sunday) had the same 24 orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, so the most-orders day is a tie at 24 orders each (the Orders metric, cancelled orders included).
